This is the story of how Jio completely transformed internet in India and the story of how Mukesh Ambani built Jio and gave internet services to the country for FREE. The video also covers challenges in Jio's growth and how it built India's internet revolution. Today, Starlink challenges Jio, but can Jio stand up and play yet another role in India's satellite internet revolution?
A video by Abhiraj Rajadhyaksha & Niyati Mavinkurve
